mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.gender, u.campus, u.bio, u.role, u.campus_verified AS campusVerified, u.post_count AS postCount, u.follow_count AS followCount, u.fans_count AS fansCount FROM user_follow f INNER JOIN sys_user u ON f.following_id = u.id WHERE f.follower_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
